baselineConfusion.note: Strong recall bias toward benign; almost fails to separate Replay from DoS.
Improves on the linear baseline but Replay recall stays low (20.9%).
Best central baseline; the DoS/Replay boundary is already visibly the weak point.
Privacy-preserving but a lower ceiling than central RF at this client scale.

cleaningSteps: Removed rows with missing/invalid class label (21,681 rows)
Median imputation + robust scaling, fitted on the training split only

federatedLearning.note: Communication-efficient top-k update compression halves per-round upload size (413,792 → 206,872 bytes) with no architecture change.

explainability.method: Permutation-importance fallback — SHAP was designed into the pipeline, but the SHAP package was unavailable in the evaluation environment, so the system automatically fell back to permutation importance rather than silently skipping explainability.

contributions.title: Hierarchical Federated Learning
contributions.text: An 8-client, 2-cluster architecture validated under severe Dirichlet(α=0.30) non-IID partitioning — no raw traffic ever leaves a client.

contributions.title: Non-IID-Aware Training
contributions.text: Explicitly modeled and measured under heterogeneous per-client class distributions, not assumed away.

contributions.title: Explainable AI
contributions.text: Every classification decision is paired with a feature-importance signal, supporting operator trust and forensic analysis.

contributions.title: Continual Learning
contributions.text: Replay-buffer incremental updates measurably improve macro F1 on new data chunks without retraining from scratch.

contributions.title: Hybrid Detection Architecture
contributions.text: An autoencoder's anomaly signal reused as classifier input, stacked with 5 supervised models — validated as a genuine accuracy gain, not just an ensemble average.

contributions.title: Quantum-Resilient Design
contributions.text: Post-quantum signing designed into the update pipeline; the system reports honestly when the crypto backend is unavailable rather than silently downgrading security.

futureWork: Scale federated validation from 8 simulated clients to 100+ node swarms as originally scoped
Execute native post-quantum signing (CRYSTALS-Kyber/Dilithium) once liboqs is available in the deployment environment
Add LIME alongside the current permutation/SHAP explainability path for cross-validated interpretability
Evaluate on a second, independent UAV capture dataset to test cross-dataset generalization
Investigate sequence/flow-level features to test whether the DoS/Replay ceiling can be moved beyond 72-77%
